questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of disability limitation for polio?

options.label: A
options.text: Polio immunization drives for infants to reduce the occurence.

options.label: B
options.text: Arranging for schooling for a child suffering from residual polio paralysis.

options.label: C
options.text: Resting the limbs affected by polio in neutral position.

options.label: D
options.text: Providing calipers for walking to patients affected by polio.
